cards.title: RACK TECH
cards.concept: night-shift data-centre technician in worn grey coveralls, a coiled bundle of network cable slung over one shoulder and a battered hand scanner with one tiny cyan LED held at his chest.
cards.hook: Engineering roots in the compute world: Compute Labs' GPUs live in racks like these.

cards.title: TAP-TO-PAY TECH
cards.concept: street repair tech in a grey utility vest over a rolled-sleeve shirt, a scuffed card-payment terminal held open at his chest and a small screwdriver tucked behind his ear.
cards.hook: Mastercard alum: he knows every payment terminal from the inside.

cards.title: BETA TESTER
cards.concept: cheerful beta tester in a grey hoodie with the hood down, a chunky handheld test device with a sticky note on its corner raised at chest height and a cheap earpiece in one ear.
cards.hook: Product management: the first person to try every build before the users do.

cards.title: SHIFT LEAD
cards.concept: night-shift crew lead in a grey work jacket with a reflective armband, a rugged slate showing a small crew roster with cyan check marks tucked under one arm, his other hand giving a thumbs-up, an easy grin on his face.
cards.hook: Technical and administrative leadership: the shift lead the whole night crew is happy to follow.

cards.title: SALVAGE AUDITOR
cards.concept: sharp-eyed salvage auditor in a patched grey utility jacket, holding a small crate of neatly tagged circuit boards and an old graphics card at his chest, a battered calculator-terminal clipped to the crate lid with a green-and-grey ledger of numbers on its screen.
cards.hook: Former non-profit CFO: he finds the value in every part and makes a lean budget go further.

cards.title: PRODUCT NETRUNNER
cards.concept: netrunner in a dark techwear jacket with green terminal-code piping, a compact cyberdeck with a green screen at his chest and a thin data cable running to a small implant on his temple.
cards.hook: Engineer turned product leader: he can jack straight into the stack he is building.

cards.title: DRONE DISPATCHER
cards.concept: delivery dispatcher in a grey-and-green techwear vest, a wrist controller glowing green on his raised forearm and a small quadcopter drone carrying a parcel hovering above his shoulder.
cards.hook: Product management: every launch is a delivery, and he flies it in on time.

cards.title: FRIENDLY FIXER
cards.concept: easy-going fixer in a dark jacket with green-lit collar trim, a burner phone with a green screen in one hand and a data chip held up between two fingers, a tiny implant glinting on the back of his hand.
cards.hook: Technical and administrative leadership: the fixer who gets the right people onto the right job, with a smile.

cards.title: IMPLANT DOC
cards.concept: street chrome medic in a grey-green field jacket with a green cross patch, a compact injector with a green readout at his chest and a coiled data cable draped around his neck like a stethoscope.
cards.hook: His warm bedside manner: the chrome medic everyone trusts with their implants.

cards.title: GPU GAUNTLETEER
cards.concept: elite engineer in a sleek armoured jacket with glowing teal seams, raising a heavy gauntlet built from a graphics card beside his chest, its twin fans glowing faint cyan.
cards.hook: Engineer and CPO of a company that tokenises GPUs: he wields the product itself.

cards.title: TOKEN BROKER
cards.concept: sharp data broker in a long dark coat with glowing teal seams and a high collar, a glowing cyan hexagonal token hovering above his open palm at chest height.
cards.hook: From Mastercard's payment network to tokenised GPUs: value moves as tokens in both worlds.

cards.title: SCOPE SAMURAI
cards.concept: street samurai in a teal-seamed armoured long coat, the hilt of a holo-katana at his shoulder with its faint cyan blade angled up behind his head.
cards.hook: Product management: the sharpest skill of all is cutting scope clean.

cards.title: CHROME CFO
cards.concept: chrome-augmented executive with polished chrome shoulder plates over a sharp dark suit and violet-lit lapels, a large glowing magenta holographic bar chart rising behind his shoulders.
cards.hook: Former non-profit CFO, now upgraded: the books balance at chrome speed.

cards.title: HYPERSCALER
cards.concept: chrome-augmented legend in heavy chrome shoulder armour threaded with violet-lit cable conduits, a towering violet and hot-pink holographic stack of server racks glowing behind his shoulders.
cards.hook: Engineering and product leadership in the compute world: build it, then scale it to the size of a data centre.

cards.title: COMPUTE SOVEREIGN
cards.concept: ascended sovereign in gold and white chrome regalia with a high collar, a crown of glowing golden GPU cores ringed by cyan circuit lines floating above his head, a radiant golden token core cradled at his chest.
cards.hook: Chief Product Officer of a company turning GPUs into on-chain assets: the ruler of product in the compute age.
